title: Linux: build a proper Fedora RPM
notes: `build-linux-packages.py --bundles rpm` restores the verified OpenVINO runtime in Tauri's RPM and repackages it with rpmbuild: files keep their bytes, License AGPL-3.0-only, library requirements generated from the binaries, bundled libraries excluded from provides/requires. Installs with dnf. Written with Claude Code.
